disclosures.subject: The hidden transaction
known_by: Ragna sees a list and Merrok signature
Ilva knows at least some of the concealment
disclosures.reader: Sees only what Ragna observes; the purpose and Dorrik’s cause of death remain unknown.

disclosures.subject: The household iron discrepancy
known_by: Sella and Neri know they received twenty bars
Ragna knows the note signed by Dorrik recorded forty
Orren recalls Dorrik planned to find the other cart
Sella, Neri and Ragna know of Merrok’s signature; Sella has the original fragment
disclosures.reader: Knows a discrepancy exists, but not where the remaining iron went or why Dorrik signed.

disclosures.subject: Redirected twenty bars
known_by: Venn admits he altered the destination to Thorn depot
Sella and Ragna hold attested copies
disclosures.reader: Knows Venn says Harrow’s office issued an instruction, but his copy does not bear Harrow’s signature and payment source remains unproved.

disclosures.subject: Dorrik’s death and the accounts
known_by: Kelm admits removing the rail and gives the top-side account
Brann reports his limited bottom-of-shaft observation
Sella and Neri hear Kelm’s account
Merrok admits authorising the duplicate posting
disclosures.reader: Learns the reconstructed local incident and financial chain; wider rebellion remains unresolved.
